csv_project_name: DB for New Modular Home Construction
csv_scope_of_work: he Red Cliff Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Indians are requesting sealed bid proposals from qualified contractors/manufacture representatives for new modular home construction and new manufactured homes located on the Red Cliff Reservation in Bayfield, Wisconsin. The Red Cliff tribe has invested in two 8-unit apartment buildings, 3 new roads, and utility infrastructure for each property. Design-Build Services will include the following: 1. Work with Red Cliff Planning Department to finalize finishes 2. Provide slab and/or modular specifications for foundation 3. Price should include shipping and setting house. 4. House to be finished and turned over to owner ready to occupy.
